Rohan Mehta
Mumbai, Maharashtra | rohan.mehta@example.com

Equity Research Associate, Kesar Capital Securities, Mumbai (Jul 2022 - Present)
- Built and maintained financial modelling templates for 14 auto ancillary companies, updating forecasts after each quarterly result
- Wrote quarterly results update notes and co-authored an initiating coverage report on the auto components sector
- Derived target prices using relative valuation on EV/EBITDA and P/E multiples, cross-checked with a DCF
- Performed ratio analysis on annual reports to flag working capital and cash conversion trends
- Tracked sector coverage of 14 listed stocks with monthly channel checks with dealers

Junior Research Analyst, Vridhi Investment Advisors, Pune (Jun 2021 - Jun 2022)
- Prepared stock screens in advanced Excel with pivot tables for the portfolio manager

Education: MBA (Finance), B.Com. CFA Level I cleared.
Skills: Bloomberg Terminal, Capitaline, Excel
